q: Ever since the hackers stole the NFTs, Becerra has been trying to tell everyone on the internet not to buy them from the hackers. “Help me get my pfp [profile picture]^([sic]) ape back! Don’t let them win! Please don’t bid or pay for these stolen apes,” he wrote on Twitter.
